headline: South African Rand Gains 0.9% as Commodity Prices Rise and Dollar Softens
summary: The South African rand strengthened to 17.4325 per US dollar, up 0.9%, bolstered by firmer commodity prices and broader US dollar softness following Federal Reserve policy comments.
why: The South African rand is an emerging market benchmark currency strongly linked to global precious metals and mineral export prices.

impacts.name: South African Rand
impacts.why: Strengthened commodity export prices and a weaker dollar supported rand appreciation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Higher commodity prices and dollar softness lifted demand for South Africa's currency.
